compare.unsupported: Not yet supported in compare mode; shown on the left only
compare.handleHint: Drag or use the arrow keys; Esc ends compare
compare.mobileFallback: Side-by-side compare is desktop-only for now; showing a single map.
compare.hintBody: Drag the handle to compare. In each layer's settings, choose to show it on the left, right or both.
compare.hintUnsupported: {count} layers are shown on the left only in compare mode.
compare.countriesUnsupported: Not yet supported side by side; drawn on the left map only
compare.modeSliderHint: One place; drag the handle to compare eras or periods
compare.modeCountriesHint: One country on each side, at the same scale
compare.scaleLockOnHint: Both sides share one scale (zoom adjusted for latitude); click to zoom each side on its own
compare.scaleLockOffHint: Each side zooms on its own; click to match the scale
compare.timeAlignInstantHint: Both sides show the same instant (local clocks differ)
compare.timeAlignLocalHint: Each side shows the same clock time in its own country (e.g. Taiwan 08:00 vs UK 08:00, 8 hours apart)
compare.countriesHintBody: Layers of the right-hand country are drawn on the right, all others on the left. Both sides share one scale by default and show the same moment.
compare.countriesHintUnsupported: {count} layers of the right-hand country are not yet supported side by side and are drawn on the left map only.
